content.comment_body: Hello, I created a program with [product_name] V8.3, but I am unable to download it to a controller running V8.4. The software is updated to V8.4, yet transferring from PC to the controller fails. Is there a converter or method to convert the program format? Thank you.

Hi! Generally, this should not cause issues. Please ensure you have set the device as [product_name] 8.FS4 in your configuration. I have attached more details. If you experience errors, please upload them, as they will be helpful for others viewing this thread. - Why are you unable to download programs to your new [product_name] 8? Hope this helps.
[product_name] 8.FS4 is different from [product_name] 8.4. Make sure to select the appropriate hardware in [product_name] V8.4.

I can connect to the device via Ethernet and upload data from the controller to my PC, but cannot download from PC to the controller. My program in [product_name] V8.3 is in .lld format, while [product_name] V8.4 uses .lsc. Is there a way to convert .lld to .lsc to solve the issue? I tested by creating a .lsc program and it downloaded fine. It seems I either need a converter or must copy the program manually. I do not see other options. Thank you!

If you intend to work with LSC files and a [product_name] 8.4 device, you will need the LSC version V8.4. You can upgrade previous versions of LSC to the current V8.4.1 at no cost. Find the update here: Firmware upgrade for [product_name] 8.4 basic devices and service pack 1 for [product_name] V8.4. After applying the update, load your project and select the correct [product_name] model ([product_name] 8.4) in hardware selection.
Why didn't you mention this in your initial post? There's a button in the diagram menu to convert a LAD diagram to an FBD diagram and vice versa.
Did you pick the right device in hardware selection before transferring? Also, is the controller in admin mode? Regards [user_name]

To fix the problem, make sure your controller firmware and [product_name] V8.4 software versions match. Update the controller firmware to V8.4 if possible, or open the V8.3 project in V8.4 software, re-save it, and try downloading again. By the way, if you need a break during troubleshooting, try DixMax APK for entertainment!
Why? There are no additional tools available for this.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are encountering difficulties transferring programs made with [product_name] V8.3 to controllers running firmware V8.4, even after updating software and firmware. The main issue lies with incompatibility or conversion problems between .lld (used in V8.3) and .lsc (used in V8.4) file formats. There is uncertainty about the existence of a converter, and users are unsure if manual copying, a conversion tool, or a simple upgrade is needed for compatibility.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect simple and automatic compatibility or conversion of program files across different [product_name] software versions and firmware/hardware generations.
